description: Compute one indicator series over recent candles — No api_key. USDT perpetual pairs. exchange is binance, bybit, or okx; symbol like BTCUSDT, one of get_available_pairs for that exchange (unlisted or malformed symbols are refused); timeframe is 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, or 1w (not interval). query_candles and calculate_indicator may require x402 USDC payment when enabled — invalid args are rejected before payment, and a tool error is never settled, so it costs nothing. Use indicator_id from list_indicators (not indicator). Paid when x402 is enabled. US stocks and ETFs: exchange tiingo, symbol a ticker such as NVDA or BRK-B (find one by ticker or company name with get_available_pairs exchange tiingo + query), timeframe 5m, 15m, 1h, 1d, 1w, 1M, at most 500 split-adjusted bars, with attribution.

exchange.description: Exchange (binance, bybit, okx, hyperliquid, tiingo; tiingo = US stocks and ETFs)

limit.description: Number of candles to use (default 200, max 2000)

output_field.description: Output series of a multi-output indicator; omit for the default series. Valid per indicator_id: macd: macd | signal | histogram; bollinger: upper | middle | lower; stochastic: k | d; adx: adx | plus_di | minus_di; ichimoku: tenkan_sen | kijun_sen | senkou_a | senkou_b | chikou; candle: open | high | low | close | body_pct | upper_wick_pct | lower_wick_pct | range_pct | is_green; reference_candle: found | open | mid | high | low; beta_btc: beta | corr. Any other output_field is refused before payment.

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTCUSDT), or a US stock / ETF ticker with exchange tiingo (e.g., NVDA)

name: calculate_indicator
title: Calculate Indicator
